notes:
POC focused on embeddings + semantic search for product and help center search. Mid-market SaaS (analytics) targeting improved discovery and relevance for customer-facing product docs and internal KB. Initial ask: Hosted API eval for fast time-to-value, then transition to Dedicated if throughput/cost justify.

Key outcomes from demo 2026-02-14:
- Ran end-to-end demo with sample product docs (120k docs). Search latency looked good in demo (p50 ~85ms with hosted embeddings + Pinecone test).
- Team impressed by auto-batching suggestions and per-token breakdown in console.
- Quote from Head of Product: "Need predictable cost when we go big—can't have wild per-query spikes."

Technical constraints / asks:
- Throughput targets: interactive search QPS 200-500 (peak), target p50 < 120ms end-to-end for query+vector search.
- Batch embedding jobs: nightly jobs expected ~200k embeddings/day initially (scale to 1M/day in 6 months). Want efficient bulk upload API and resumable batching.
- Vector DB integration: primary testbed is Pinecone; also evaluating Milvus for cheaper storage. Need clear integration docs and sample connectors; want a recommended architecture for hybrid: Redwood hosted embeddings + external vector store.
- Model preferences: leaning to Redwood-curated open models for embeddings (small/quantized) to reduce unit cost; fallback routes to larger models for quality-critical queries.
- Cost sensitivity: high; do not want 3x cost increase vs current in-house embed pipeline. Interested in Optimize suggestions (quantization/batching) to hit target ARR.
- Security/compliance: must pass SaaS security questionnaire, SOC2 evidence required, SSO via SAML, audit logs for embeddings ingestion and query. Data residency: US-only for customer data.

POC plan agreed:
- POC scope: ingest ~350k canonical product + KB docs; run parallel workflows to Pinecone and to Redwood-managed vector indexing for comparison.
- Evaluation metrics: recall @10, latency distribution (p50/p95/p99), cost per 1k queries, nightly batch throughput and retry behavior.
- Timeline: POC kickoff 2026-02-21, 3-week active test window, decision by end of May to align with Q2 budget cycle.

Commercial discussion:
- Asking for hosted per-embed baseline pricing and Dedicated reserved capacity pricing for predicted steady-state (commit options: 3/6/12 months). Customer asking for an example ARR model given their projected scale.
- SE/Riley provided preliminary TCO calc; AE/Jordan to follow up with pricing slide (Drive link above).

Open technical questions:
- How does Redwood handle large incremental re-indexes (partial TTL/rewrite) w/ external vector DBs?
- Can we get a sample throughput bench that mirrors 200-500 QPS with 50k/hr batch concurrency?

Contacts:
- Head of Product: Maya Chen (maya@brightframe.ai) — owns use-case and final decision.
- Eng lead (search infra): Carlos Mendes (carlos@brightframe.ai) — technical POC contact.
- Procurement/legal: Lela Ortiz (lela@brightframe.ai) — will run contracts/security questionnaire.

Short-form next steps (internal):
- AE: send tailored pricing + example ARR models (Jordan)
- SE: deliver connector sample and batch ingestion playbook, run scale bench (Riley)
- SRE/Trust: prep SOC2 artifacts and SAML integration notes for Lela

CRM tone: lots of fragments, follow-ups scheduled, leaning towards Dedicated if we can prove predictable TCO and vector-store integration story.
